items.prompt: After processing n records with this partial-acceptance policy, which count equation must hold?

options.text: Accepted count is always equal ton
Rejected count equals the number of unique IDs
options.why: Rejection reasons include other failures and duplicates.

options.text: Accepted plus rejected counts equal n
options.why: Every processed record appears in exactly one result branch.

options.text: Accepted count equals rejected count for every batch
options.why: The input does not force an even split.

items.explanation: The two report branches partition the processed records. A missing or double-counted record violates that invariant even if the notional happens to match.
